title: Choose the visual world for brickbot.ro (round 9)
question: Note: the catalog ran out of bold challengers for this seed, so this hand is built from my own new directions. The roll assigned Media Day.

options.label: Media Day
options.lineage: pro-sports media days: each player shot on a seamless coloured backdrop under studio light
options.thesis: The students treated like a pro squad on media day: shot against a brand-yellow seamless backdrop, big prints with hard studio shadows; the robot is part of the squad.
materials: yellow seamless paper sweep with a floor falloff
large prints with hard offset studio shadows
options.viewport: Yellow sweep: the black wordmark, 'We build our future brick by brick.', one plain line (students of CNU Focșani; in 2026 we qualified for the FIRST Championship), 'Partner with us'. On the right, three big prints of the students cast hard shadows on the sweep.
options.risk: Built to be dark-first, the brand gets a yellow-drenched hero here (dark sections below). It reaches full power only with a real media-day shoot of the team; today's candids stand in until then.

options.label: Flash
options.lineage: flash-lit candid event photography: hard light, deep black, the moment caught
options.thesis: Electricity as the camera flash: the page is black, and the students' moments burst out of it in hard flash light, with the bolt as the flash.
materials: flash-lit, high-contrast prints with white edges
the bolt as the flash mark
a faint yellow spill of light
options.viewport: The wordmark, the motto, a plain line and 'Partner with us' on the left; three flash-lit prints of the students burst out of the dark on the right, with a yellow bolt where the flash fired.
options.risk: Familiar: dark-with-photos is close to the category look; the flash treatment and the motion (prints flashing in once) carry the difference.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark team site with the wordmark, the motto and a yellow accent, built to the level of team254.com.
canonCard.viewport: The team photo with the wordmark, the motto and two buttons.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other strong team's site.
